Etsy sellers, before you panic about the new AI image rules… READ THIS. 👇 Etsy is NOT banning AI-generated images or mockups across the board. But there are some important distinctions sellers need to understand. Here's what you need to know: ✨ AI-generated digital products are still permitted when they meet Etsy's Creativity Standards, including disclosure requirements. ✨ Print-on-demand sellers can still use qualifying mockups, but your images need to accurately represent the product your customer will receive. ✨ Handmade and physical product sellers have stricter photo requirements. Not every AI-generated lifestyle image is acceptable as a replacement for real product photography. #etsysellersoftiktok #etsysmallbusiness #printondemand #fyppp #etsymockups

👀 I can’t believe how much money these shirts are making on Etsy! For print on demand, you create the design or get a done for you design, put it on products, list them in your shop, and when someone orders, your print-on-demand company makes and ships the product for you. 🙌 Some of the best products to test are: 👕 T-shirts ☕️ Mugs 👜 Tote bags 🧥 Sweatshirts & hoodies 📱 Phone cases 🖼️ Wall art & prints 🥤 Tumblers & water bottles ✨ Stickers 📓 Notebooks & journals 👶 Baby & kids apparel But here’s where a LOT of people get stuck… Creating enough good designs to actually fill a shop takes so much time. And the more products and niches you want to test, the more designs you need. That’s exactly why I love using done-for-you designs. Inside the ctrl-alt-design.com membership, you can get ready-made designs that you can put on your own print-on-demand products and sell. Instead of spending hours making every design yourself, you can focus that time on getting more high-quality listings up, testing more products and niches, and actually growing your shop. You add the designs to your products, sell them through your own shop, and keep the money you make from your sales after your normal platform and fulfillment costs. 💸 You don’t need to be a professional designer to start a print-on-demand business. You just need good products, good designs, and enough listings out there to figure out what your customers actually want.
